title: Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 on two RTX 5060 Ti 16GB cards with vLLM
purpose: Recommended dual-card OpenAI-compatible Qwen3.8 route for high-context prefill, MTP3 decode, reasoning parsing, and tool calls.
caveats: The explicit 2.50 GB KV allocation is required for repeatable warm-cache starts; automatic sizing over-allocated KV after cached compilation and could OOM on real prefills.
Full-context concurrency is 1.00x and max-num-seqs is deliberately 1.
The measured 118,660-token median is 952.50 tok/s prefill and 67.29 tok/s decode; this does not meet the experimental 1,000 tok/s prefill target.
FP8 KV and NVFP4 weights are not quality-equivalent to the separate llama.cpp Q6_K/f16-KV preset.
